theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (a : Euclid P), (∀ i, |a i - 1 / 2| < 1 / 4) → ∃ Ψ : ℕ → Euclid P → Euclid P, (∀ x, Ψ (m + 1) x = x) ∧ ∀ j, m + 2 ≤ j → j ≤ P → ∀ (b : Fin P → ℤ) (J : Finset (Fin P)) (hJ : J.Nonempty), J.card = j → ∀ x : Euclid P, (∀ i, (i ∈ J → (b i : ℝ) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ b i + 1) ∧ (i ∉ J → x i = b i)) → ∀ y : Euclid P, (∀ i, y i = if i ∈ J then (b i : ℝ) + a i + (x i - b i - a i) / J.sup' hJ (fun k => max ((x k - b k - a k) / (1 - a k)) ((b k + a k - x k) / a k)) else x i) → Ψ j x = Ψ (j - 1) y
